property_summary: After calling transfer with a single-element array, the function should succeed, not revert.
When the _tos array has exactly one element, calling transfer must succeed (not revert).
When called with _tos array of length 1, the transfer function must succeed and return true.
When called with _tos array of length 1, the transfer function must succeed (not revert) and return true.
Calling transfer with _tos array of length 1 must succeed (not revert).
The transfer function must revert when the _tos array is empty.
The transfer function must not revert when the _tos array is non-empty.
The contract's transfer function must revert when called with any non-empty _tos array.
The transfer function must revert when the _tos array is non-empty
The transfer function must perform external calls to all addresses in _tos when _tos is non-empty
After transfer, the token of address _tos[0] should have been transferred from 'from' to '_tos[0]' if _tos length is > 0, but mutant skips index 0.
After a call to transfer(address,address,address[],uint256) with _tos length > 0, the function must have attempted a transferFrom call for index 0 of _tos.
When _tos length is greater than 0, transfer must attempt a transferFrom for every address in _tos, including the first one.
After transfer, the balance of _tos[0] (or its token balance) must be updated by v, but mutant skips index 0.
When _tos length is 1, transfer must succeed (revert if caddress is not a token contract), but the mutant reverts because it never enters the loop.
For all inputs to transfer, the number of successful external calls equals the number of elements in the _tos array.
After calling transfer, the return value is true for all valid inputs.
Calling transfer with an odd length _tos array results in the same return value for both C and M.
For any call to transfer with an even-length _tos array, the number of external calls made equals the length of _tos (i.e., all recipients are processed).
After calling transfer, the sum of the lengths of the _tos arrays of all calls equals the total number of successful external calls.
The transfer call should succeed when the underlying token is ERC20 compliant and the sender has sufficient allowance.
The transfer function should revert if the internal call fails and succeed otherwise.
After calling transfer with a valid token contract, the return value is always true, regardless of the token's transferFrom behavior.
The external call in transfer should always succeed (not revert) when the recipient address is not the zero address and the token contract is the contract itself.
The transfer function should succeed regardless of the result of the underlying transferFrom call
After calling transfer, the length of the tos array must be reflected in the number of transferFrom calls made by the contract.
After calling transfer, the contract's balance must not decrease.
After calling transfer, the contract must have made exactly the number of external calls equal to the length of the _tos array.
The contract must revert when an external call fails.
The contract must perform exactly _tos.length external calls during transfer, which can be observed via the runtime gas consumption.
